review.summary: Accept clients-and-wire attempt 3. Previous findings are resolved, implementation and recorded qualification support the scoped acceptance criteria, and no blocker/high findings remain. One low-severity recovery-file privacy issue remains.

findings.description: write_private creates the recovery file using default permissions. Direct invocation of the documented example with a typical 022 umask can expose fixture and workspace identifiers through a 0644 file. The Python runner's private temporary directory protects the recorded qualification run.
findings.required_fix: Enforce owner-only recovery-file permissions and reject unsafe existing destinations, or require and verify a private containing directory.
